Executive Summary & Strategic Paradigm Shift **Hark Pro** (launched in October 2026 by Brett Adcock, founder of Figure AI, with industrial design directed by former Apple design lead Abidur Chowdhury) represents an intentional repudiation of the legacy conversational AI paradigm. Hark rejects the blank chat box as an archaic command-line terminal, replacing it with an **ambient Graphical User Interface (GUI) and proactive Operating System for your life**.
